title: "Resourcing"

# Overview

Analyzing questions related to funding and constraints.

Research questions:\
- How are OSPOs funded?\
- What fraction of OSPO contributors are volunteers?\
- What are the OSPOs' biggest blockers?\

Relevant survey questions:\
- How are your OSPO activities funded or allocated?\
- Roughly how many people regularly spend time on OSPO activities without being formally resourced?\
- Which of the following blockers has your OSPO encountered?\


# Import packages, utilities, and config variables
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(docstring)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

source("utils.R")

# Read config.yml
cfg <- config::get()
```

# Load data
```{r}
org_responses <- read_excel(file.path(cfg$curated_path, "orgs.xlsx"), sheet="responses")

ai_usage <- read_tsv(file.path(cfg$data_path, "ai_usage.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE, skip_empty_rows = FALSE)
tools_reliance <- read_tsv(file.path(cfg$data_path, "tools_reliance.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE, skip_empty_rows = FALSE)
blockers <- read_tsv(file.path(cfg$data_path, "blockers.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE, skip_empty_rows = FALSE)
matrix_other <- read_tsv(file.path(cfg$data_path, "matrix_other.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE, skip_empty_rows = FALSE)

```




# What fraction of OSPO contributors are volunteers?

First, inspect answers from each org and check for disagreement from within the same org.
```{r}
mc_simple$organization <- org_responses$organization
volunteers <- mc_simple |>
    select(volunteers, organization)

dupes <- volunteers |>
  group_by(organization) |>
  filter(n() > 1) |> 
  arrange(organization, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  select(volunteers, organization)

# Keep commented for privacy!!
# dupes
```

Okay, great. I can see that only at one university did all respondents give a consistent answer. Similar to what I did in the "tools" notebook, I am going to just take the largest of the answers, because I expect that people are more likely to underestimate than overestimate on this one.

```{r}
# Order of preference: keep whichever is further down the list
ordered_sizes <- c(
    "I don't know",
    "None",
    "1 person",
    "2 to 5 people",
    "6-10 people"
)

volunteers_consolidated <- volunteers |>
  mutate(volunteers = factor(volunteers, levels = ordered_sizes)) |>
  group_by(organization) |>
  slice_max(volunteers, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(volunteers = as.character(volunteers))


volunteers_consolidated |> count(volunteers)
```
